angleEvidenceBrief: Three photographs from the USGS Hawaiian Volcano Observatory, pulled off its own media pages on 23 August 2026, showing the floor of Halemaʻumaʻu being rebuilt: the observatory’s fixed B1cam at episode 1 and at episode 50 eighteen months later, the 16 July overflight of the resurfaced western floor, and the 12 August panorama of episode 53. The evidence is the photographs; every number on the frame is the observatory’s, quoted from its own 16 July 2026 Volcano Watch article, and G1 returned unverifiable because the frozen manifest is a photograph manifest with no quantity in it. One photograph has no photographer and its credit says so; its alt text was written at the desk by a person who opened the file, because nothing mechanical may write one.
